as_told.title: Hawkeye 360 patent as how aliens could track implant beacons

plain: A former CIA contractor named Bob McGwier says he wrote a patent that explains how implants in people could be tracked, and that this is how aliens would find such beacons anywhere on Earth. He tells it on the show as his own work. He says: "I didn't believe these stories at all about these implants and them being tracking until I wrote the patent that tells you how they do it." The implants he means are devices that some people say were placed in their bodies during alien encounters. In a second remark in the same conversation, he ties the patent to a name he gives as Hawkeye 360. He says that is "how the aliens would find these beacons all over the planet." Both mentions come from McGwier himself, and no outside record of the patent is given. He tells it because, to him, the patent made the implant stories technically believable.
